Kadyr tun emne ekenin (eger Biz uirotposok,) sen kaidan bilmek elen'?! [1]
Kadyr tunu min' aidan da zhakshy.
(Antkeni,) bul tunu perishteler zhana Rukh (Zhebireiil) Rabbisinin uruksaty boiuncha, ar turduu ishter menen (zher betine ) tushushot.
Al tan'ga cheiin salamattyk(tyn tunu)! [1]
Kitep eelerinen (iakhudiler zhana khristiandardan) zhana mushrikterden bolgon kaapyrlar alarga Anyk Chyndyk kelmeiinche (adashuuchulugunan) azhyrai alyshpady. [1]
(Anyk Chyndyk - al) taza baraktardy (Kurandy) okup bergen Allakhtyn elchisi.
Al baraktarda akyikatty baiandagan zhazuular bar.
Kitep berilgen elder (iakhudiler menen khristiandar) alarga "Anyk Chyndyk" kelgenden kiiin gana bolunup ketishti. [1]
Alar bardyk ibadattardy kalys Allakh uchun gana kyluuga, andan (zheke kudaiga syiynuudan) bashka dinden zhuz buruuga, namaz okuuga, zeket beruugo buiurulushkan ele zhana dal ushul gana Tuura Din!
Kitep elderi zhana mushrikterden bolgon kaapyrlar tozok otunun ichinde! Al zherde tuboluk kalyshat! Alar (chyndykty bilip turup zhuz burgany sebeptuu) zharatylgandardyn en' zhamany!
Al emi yiman keltirip, salikh amaldardy zhasagan adamdar... alar - zharatylgandardyn en' zhakshysy.

Rabbisinin aldynda alardyn syilyktary - anda daiym zhashoochu beiishter! Alardyn tubunon daryialar agyp turat zhana alar anda tuboluk kalyshat. (Munun sebebi) alardan Allakh yraazy boldu, alar Allakhtan yraazy bolushtu. Bul (syilyktar) Rabbisinen korkkon adamdar uchun!
Zher katuu titiregende [1]
zhana ozunun "zhuktorun" chygaryp tashtaganda... [1]
Insan (korkup zhana tan' kalyp) "buga emne boldu?!" deit.
Oshol Kundo zher oz kabarlaryn suiloit.
Antkeni, aga Rabbin' ("suilo!" dep) vakhii kylgan. [1]
Al Kunu adamdar amaldary korgozulushu uchun top-top bolup kelishet.
Zhana kim kypyn salmagyndai [1] zhakshylyk kylgan bolso - any korot
zhana kim kypyn salmagyndai zhamandyk zhasagan bolso - oshonu korot.
Alkynyp churkagan tulparlarga ant! [1]
(Tuiagynan) ot chachyrata churkagan attarga ant!
Tan' azanda (dushmanga) chabuul koigon attarga ant!
Oshondo alar (chabuulu menen) topurakty yzgytty.
Andan son' (dushman) toptorunun ortosuna zharyp kirdi. [1]
Insan degen anygynda, Rabbisine nashukur! [1]
Buga anyn ozu dele kubodur!
Al bailykty katuu suiot!
Bilbeibi al murzodogu oluktor chygarylganda...
Kokuroktogu syrlar ashkere kylynganda...
Oshol Kunu Rabbisi kabardar go, alardan?! [1]
Kori'a! [1]
Kori'a emne ozu?! [1]
(Oo, Mukhammad!) Sen Kori'a emne ekenin bilbeisin'!
Al kundo adamdar tozup ketken (tun'ku) kopoloktor syiaktuu bolup (durbolon'go tushup) kalat. [1]
Toolor tytylgan zhun syiaktuu bolot!
Emi, (al kundo) kimdin (soop) tarazasy oor kelse,
yraazy bolo turgan zhashoodo (beiishte) bolot.
Al emi, kimdin (soop) tarazasy zhen'il kelse,
anyn enesi - <<Khaaviia!>>
(Oo, Mukhammad) sen <<Khaaviia>> emne ekenin bilbeisin'.
Al - katuu kyzytylgan tozok!
(Duino, bala-chaka) koboituu (zhana any menen syimyktanuu) silerdi (ibadattan) alaksytyp koidu! [1]
Tee murzogo kelgenin'erge cheiin.
Zhok! (Omur degen duinogo kul boluu uchun berilgen emes!) Siler (munu) zhakynda bilip alasyn'ar!
Dagy bir iret zhok! Siler zhakynda (Kyiamattagy sot-surak uchurunda) bilip alasyn'ar!
Andai emes, Eger siler (chyndykty ushul duinodo) anyk bilgenin'erde (duinogo kul bolboit elen'er).
(Emi) tozoktu korushun'or anyk!
Anan any albette oz kozun'or menen korosun'or!
Andan son', oshol kunu (Allakh amanatka bergen) neemattar zhonundo albette suralasyn'ar!
Asyrga ant! [1]
Albette, (ar bir) insan zyianda!
Al emi, yiman keltirgen, salikh (soop) amaldardy zhasagan zhana biri-birine akyikattyk menen sabyrduuluktu osuiat (nasaat) kylgandar gana (zyianda emes).
Adamdardy kylygy zhana tili menen shyldyn'dagan bardyk shyldyn'chyga azap-tozok bolsun! [1]
Al mal-mulktu (adal-aramyna karabai) chogulttu zhana eseptedi.
Duino-mulku any tuboluk zhashatat dep oiloit.
Zhok! Alar (Kyiamatta) sozsuz <<Khutamaga>> tashtalat!
(Oo, Mukhammad!) Sen <<Khutama>> emne ekenin bilbeisin'.
(Al) Allakhtyn aloolongon tozogu,
(Deneden teship otup) zhuroktorgo cheiin zhete turgan!
Chynynda, al (tozok) alardyn ustunon zhaap koiulgan.
(Eshikteri) uzun ustundarda (bekemdelgen).
(Oo, Mukhammad!) Rabbin' pil eelerin emne kylganyn bilbedin'bi! [1]
(Rabbin') alardyn (Kaabany buzup saluu uchun oilogon) aila-amaldaryn tekke ketirbedibi?
Zhana alarga karshy top-top kushtardy zhiberdi. [1]
(Kushtar chen'gelindegi) chopo-tashtar menen alardy tashbaran'ga alyshty. [1]
(Allakh) alardy moisolgon zhalbyraktai kylyp koidu! [1]
Kuraishtyn yntymagy uchun! [1]
Kysh zhana zhai mezgilindegi saparynda alardyn yntymak-tynchtygy uchun!
Emi, alar (ar kandai tash-kudai, zhygach-kudailaryn tashtap, ozdoruno yntymak zhashoo tartuulagan) ushul Uidun (Kaabanyn) Rabbisine gana ibadat kylyshsyn!
Al (Rabbi) kaatchylykta alardy tamaktandyrdy zhana korkunuch(tar)dan aman saktady!
(Oo, Mukhammad)? sen dindi <<zhalgan>> degen kishini kordun' bele?! [1]
Mynake al, zhetimdi(n akysyna kyianattyk kylyp,) turtkulogon adam!
Zhana al zhakyrdy tamaktandyruuga (elderdi) uguttogon emes. [1]
(Kee bir) namaz okuuchularga azap-tozok bolsun!
Alar namazdaryn unutup koiushat. [1]
Alar (namazda zhana bashka ibadattarda) riia [1] kylyshat.
Zhana (muktazhdardan) buium-shaimandardy kyzganyshat.
(Oo, Mukhammad) chynynda Biz saga <<Kausardy>> berdik. [1]
Sen emi, (ushul zhakshylyktarga shugur kylyp) Rabbin' uchun namaz oku zhana kurmandyk chal!
Albette, seni aiyptagan adamdyn ozunun arty kesilgen! [1]
(Oo, Mukhammad, kaapyrlarga) aitkyn: <<Ei, kaapyrlar! [1]
Men siler ibadat kylgan(kudailar)ga ibadat kylbaimyn!
Siler dagy men syiynganga (Allakh taalaga) syiynuuchu emessin'er.
Men siler ibadat kylgan kudailarga syiynbaimyn!
Siler da men ibadat kylgan(Allakh taala)ga ibadat kyluuchu emessin'er.
(Demek,) silerge oz dinin'er, maga oz dinim!>>
(Oo, Mukhammad, eger saga) Allakhtyn zhardamy zhana zhen'ishi kelse [1]
zhana adamdardy Allakhtyn dinine top-top bolup kirip zhatkanyn korson'...
Anda, Rabbin'e khamd (maktoo) aituu menen (Any zhaman-tomon sypattardan) aruula zhana kunoolorun'du kechiruusun sura! Chynynda, Al toobolordu kabyl kyluuchu!
Abu Lakhabdyn eki kolu (ozu) kuurap kalsyn! Kuurap da kaldy! [1]
Aga mal-duinosu da, bala-chakasy da paida bergen zhok!
Al zhakynda aloolongon tozokko tashtalat!
Al emi, (paigambarga karshy doomat -ushak kotorup zhurgon) anyn aialy bolso (narky duinodo) otun kotorgon abalda!
Anyn moinunda kurma daragynyn bulasynan (eshilgen) zhip! [1]
Ait (oo, Mukhammad:) Al - Allakh zhalgyz! [1]
Allakh - Somad (Beimuktazh)
Al tuubagan zhana da tuulbagan!
Zhana ech kim Aga ten' emes!
Ait (oo, Mukhammad): <<Tan' Rabbisinen korgoo tileimin: [1]
(Ozu) zharatkan (zyianduu) nerselerdin zhamandygynan...,
Kaptap kirgen uchurdagy (karan'gy) tundun zhamandygynan..., [1]
Tuiundorgo dem salgan saikyrchylardyn zhamandygynan...,
Sugun artkan uchurda, koro albagan kishinin zhamandygynan. [1]
Aitkyn (oo, Mukhammad): <<Men insandardyn Rabbisinen [1]
Insandardyn padyshasynan;
insandardyn (syiynuuga tatyktuu bolgon) Kudaiynan korgoo tileimin -
(Allakhtyn ysymy aitylganda) zhashynyp kaluuchunun [1] zhamandygynan.
Al (shaitan) adamdardyn kokuroguno azgyryk salat.
Alar (azgyruuchu shaitandar) zhinderden zhana adamdardan bolot. [1]
